questions.question: Describe a time you drove a forklift in narrow aisles between shelves. What did you do to move and place the load safely?
Tell us about your previous warehouse or logistics work. What tasks did you handle yourself, and what did a typical workday involve?
How have you used Finnish at work, for example when speaking with colleagues or following work instructions?
Describe your experience receiving, inspecting or handling tyres. What checks did you make, and how did you handle the tyres?
